title: Brand UI
summary: A reference spike for a multi-brand Angular UI library: four signal-based standalone components (Button, TextInput, Card, Navigation) themed per brand through design tokens.
evidence: Gallery app consumes the library the way an outside user would.
Explicitly a reference spike, not production software.

title: IDP-Align
summary: A research prototype applying CAV Level 1 (observed-state divergence) to document-processing workflow data.
evidence: Uses synthetic replay data shaped from public API documentation; no customer data.
Not affiliated with any vendor.
modwRelevance: Built under MOD-W v5.0.1 with planning, review, QA and Moderator gates.

title: Continuous Alignment Verification (CAV)
summary: An open methodology and maturity model for checking continuously whether evolving systems stay behaviorally aligned, not only healthy.
evidence: Manifesto, levels roadmap and foundations documents.
Its divergence-monitoring pattern is applied in Bio-Align and IDP-Align.

title: Bio-Align
summary: A digital twin simulator of a fed-batch cell-culture bioreactor with a live deviation-monitoring dashboard. The process model is my own design, fed by mock telemetry.
evidence: Applies the CAV divergence-monitoring pattern.
Zoneless, signals-only Angular 21 with Chart.js.

title: React Design Patterns
summary: A catalog of frontend design patterns in React 19 and TypeScript, refactored from my Angular Design Patterns project to compare the two frameworks.
evidence: Same patterns as Angular Design Patterns, implemented in React for direct comparison.
Tested with Vitest and Playwright.

title: Angular Design Patterns
summary: An instructional catalog of design patterns built with Angular 21, started as an experiment in modern Angular features and AI-generated code.
evidence: Each pattern is documented and tested with Vitest and Playwright.

title: Cavalieri Align / MQTT-Align
summary: An independent SaaS product for real-time MQTT-based alignment and monitoring, built and shipped through the MOD-W workflow.
evidence: MVP vertical slice delivered in 3 weeks.
Architecture walk-through available on request.

title: AGV Fleet Management Simulator
summary: A simulator of an automated guided vehicle (AGV) fleet using MQTT over WebSockets and the VDA-5050 messaging standard, with 2D and 3D fleet visualization.
evidence: Organized with Domain-Driven Design.
Includes a gateway and Mosquitto broker setup.
